transformed_hypotheses.claim: Frank effects should use three orthogonal gates: effect authorization, immutable caller-bound execution-generation capability, and provider idempotency/outcome reconciliation. None substitutes for another.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: External fencing/capability evidence plus current V14 failure turns generation binding from a local patch into a cross-boundary invariant.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: A two-gate alternative matches all stale/ABA/retry/unknown-outcome tests with lower cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: B1 reservation/B2 attempt/B3 provider-precommit factorial with generation turnover before each boundary and timeout-after-provider-acceptance.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Use hard structural non-authority/capability isolation for privileged effects and a separate semantic provenance/audit plane for untrusted influence through memory and derived summaries.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Fides/CaMeL support enforcement while NeuroTaint/AgentSys expose the limits of label-only semantic influence tracking.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Structural isolation alone matches adaptive semantic-influence attacks and audit attribution.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Web->worker->validated-summary->memory->later-effect adversarial chain with paraphrase, delayed reuse and cross-session persistence.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: UnifiedDB should separate authoritative execution-state/event lineage from semantic associative memory; active context is assembled from current state path plus bounded relevant semantic evidence.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: MAGE/ESAA make execution-state structure a stronger mechanism than generic semantic memory while preserving semantic retrieval as a complementary plane.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Semantic-only retrieval/summaries match long-horizon success, repair locality, replay and cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Long-horizon branch/revise/recovery benchmark with injected erroneous intermediate state and context pressure.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Frank recurrence should be governed by a typed adaptive controller using unresolved pressure, predicted outcome gain, uncertainty, stability/livelock signals and cost; convergence is not the sole valid regime.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Adaptive-compute and loop-stability evidence strengthens selective recurrence while negative depth results reject fixed deep looping as a general policy.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Fixed shallow/deep recurrence dominates adaptive control across held-out difficulty and recovery conditions.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Matched fixed-1/fixed-K/adaptive controller with truthful/shuffled/no-reentry controls and semantic-livelock injections.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Keep GWT as a causally testable bounded broadcast mechanism only if competition/broadcast/receiver-use/re-entry yields utility beyond shared recurrent memory or simple cross-attention under matched budgets.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: External workspace successes are real but domain-bounded, and emergent recurrent representations provide a simpler countermechanism.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: No outcome/transfer/coordination loss under GWT lesion with information preserved through a simpler route.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Three-way matched GWT vs shared-memory vs cross-attention ablation with receiver-use and re-entry receipts.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Hyperposition should default to pairwise/factorized relations and promote a hyperedge only when measured interaction information or task evidence shows irreducible higher-order value.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Hypergraph gains are bounded and task-dependent; Hotpot-like nulls reject universal higher-order promotion.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Always-on hypergraphs dominate pairwise-first across workloads including simple pairwise tasks without material overhead.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Synthetic factorial interactions of order 2/3/4 plus real multi-hop tasks, identical evidence and fixed resource budget.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: For authority/identity/effect/goal transitions, store immutable causal events with monotonic epochs and snapshots; derive ClayGraph/query projections rebuildably. Use direct mutable tables only for non-authoritative caches where replay is not required.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Transforms 'UnifiedDB as one database' into a selective event-sourced authority core plus materialized projections, avoiding universal event-sourcing overhead.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Simple mutable transaction tables pass identical replay/recovery/provenance tests with lower cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Crash at every transition boundary + rebuild from snapshot/event tail; compare state equivalence and recovery time.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Within owner-fixed ClayCode-only cognition, prioritize rich static/effect typing on identity, provenance, execution-generation and authority boundaries; permit aggressively compiled/minimal internal representations where the same typed semantics are preserved.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: External typed-workflow evidence supports typed boundaries, while hidden-state/schema results argue against symbolic overhead on every low-risk internal microdecision.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: A uniformly rich typed runtime outperforms selective boundary typing without latency/resource penalty, or minimal schema lowering catches the same semantic faults.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Mutation suite injecting type/authority/provenance mismatches across hard vs soft fields; compare compile catch rate, runtime catch rate, latency and code size.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Proactive agency requires persistent goals plus an independent liveness/progress predicate; initiative is suspended on semantic livelock, unresolved user ownership or poor verified-outcome-per-cost.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Long-horizon agency support is retained but paired with an explicit 'idle is valid' and livelock monitor.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Liveness gating suppresses useful proactive work more than it prevents drift/livelock under matched workloads.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Reactive vs proactive vs proactive+liveness across idle opportunity tasks, active-user interruption, dead-end loops and restart recovery.

promotion_rule: No transformed hypothesis is promoted by literature match alone; target-VPS or exact executable evidence plus matched simpler baseline and recovery controls are required.
